evidence.detail: Each rs/gui/b/g instance owns exactly one R144 LoadoutItemEntry and lazily resolves an icon for that entry's item id.
The class owns a static ConcurrentHashMap<Integer, GuiImageAsset>, a five-thread executor, and five rs/gui/b/b/b loader workers; b() first checks that shared cache by item id.
On a cache miss b() round-robins across the five loader workers, submits the item id for asynchronous sprite creation, and returns null until the shared cache is populated.
On a cache hit the provider memoizes and returns the R345 GuiImageAsset for the wrapped loadout item entry.

candidates.note: Descriptive exact-v308 role for the lazy per-loadout-item icon provider/cache facade.

evidence.detail: LoadoutItemIconProvider constructs exactly five rs/gui/b/b/b instances, stores them in its worker array and uses them exclusively for item-id icon requests.

The loader resolves the exact item sprite through rs/d/k.a(itemId,1,0,32), scales it to 32x32, removes black background pixels, wraps the result in R345 GuiImageAsset and inserts it into the provider's shared cache by item id.
a(int) rejects -1 and submits the item-id load predicate through the existing asynchronous rs/h/a helper, keeping sprite generation off the immediate caller path.
After a successful cache insert the loader invokes the Launcher UI refresh path with the exact 100/true arguments so the newly available loadout icon can be presented.

candidates.note: Descriptive exact-v308 role for the asynchronous loadout item-icon generation worker.
